original_test_intent: Verify that the SMBIOS Type 0 BIOS Starting Address Segment is present and correct for the approved firmware implementation and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture full Type 0 plus the address-segment field, validate the hexadecimal value against the platform recipe or approved baseline, run the approved reboot and repeat the same comparison.
manual_activity: A user approves the unchanged plan and expected/baseline value. Collection, reboot and comparison can be automated.
required_inputs: Expected hexadecimal segment or approved stable-baseline rule
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not modify firmware.
Preserve raw Type 0 and errors; do not rely on grep-only evidence.
Treat missing/unsupported field separately from a numeric mismatch.
Stop on SUT mismatch, field drift or boot/management failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw Type 0/tool/platform evidence, parse the segment as a hexadecimal field, reboot under the approved plan and compare.
Do not guess the expected address, change firmware or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the platform expectation/baseline and reboot recovery.
Interpret unsupported or mismatched field behavior and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 0 query targets the correct field, but discarded stderr and grep-only output are insufficient; insecure SSH options are not approved defaults.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive dmidecode --version and complete sudo dmidecode -t 0 output with errors, then parse the exact field before/after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The linked script, field scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate field presence and hexadecimal syntax, bind the value to SMBIOS/firmware version and compare an owner-approved value or stable baseline across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Platforms whose SMBIOS Type 0 exposes this legacy field.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS entry-point, dmidecode and BIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform SMBIOS Type 0 recipe and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds field-presence semantics, hexadecimal validation and implementation binding.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Modern implementations may present legacy compatibility values; correctness is platform-defined, not inferred from a generic constant.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a platform-specific segment or persistence-only baseline. The report must state which rule was used and cannot generalize it.
expected_evidence: Approval, expectation/applicability, platform identity and tool version
Raw pre-reboot Type 0 and parsed segment
Raw post-reboot record and value diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion consistently identify the same Type 0 field; the expected value is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field and read method are clear. Missing expectation or package is readiness, not a semantic block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains the correct field but restores complete error-visible evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its baseline and recovery improvements while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Distinguishes missing-field applicability from value mismatch and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Avoids hardcoding a generic legacy segment and makes absence, malformed output and persistence distinct outcomes.
independent_technical_reasoning: No physical/UI action is required; the complete read/reboot/read workflow is software-controlled after approval, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE applies.
